# CampusCrew workspace instructions

- Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, and Lucide icons.
- Keep customer, worker, and admin areas in role-based routes.
- Preserve the 80% worker / 20% platform commission model; permit admin overrides.
- Never expose Supabase service-role credentials in browser code.
- Use server-only clients for privileged operations and browser-only clients for authenticated UI.
- Keep the UI responsive, accessible, polished, and consistent with the CampusCrew brand.
- Add demo data and setup instructions when external Supabase configuration is absent.
